name: github-my-reviews
description: Highlights GitHub PRs that need my review

scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && mkdir -p dist && bun build src/content.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format iife && cp public/manifest.json styles/github.css dist/ && cp -r public/icons dist/
scripts.build:dev: mkdir -p dist && bun build src/content.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format iife --sourcemap=linked && cp public/manifest.json styles/github.css dist/ && cp -r public/icons dist/
scripts.watch: bun run build:dev && bun build src/content.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format iife --sourcemap=linked --watch
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check
